Here is a video excerpt from our online concert 'Come Home Christmas' which premiered on the 22nd of Dec and is available on popular demand till the 1st of Jan at the following link - . All proceeds go to the Genesis Foundation which aids in the treatment of under privileged children suffering from Congenital Heart Disease.
Our version of Silent Night which is from our new album 'Come Home Christmas', is sung in Khasi, Modern Aramaic & English. Listen to the album on Spotify and other major streaming platforms -
